rv.q: It’s a production shimmering with mischievous humour, laced with the longings of a throng who would sooner suffer a forfeit than betray their true feelings for one another.
Everything drifts by pleasantly enough, but without urgency, without heat.
Following the Bath run, the production tours to Guildford, Birmingham, Sheffield, Malvern, Oxford, and Poole, and will no doubt leave a trail of good feeling in its wake.

cn.t: Critics find this traditional adaptation of Austen's classic a high-spirited, humorous production that delights devoted fans, though some question whether it fully justifies another stage version of the oft-adapted novel.
